thread:
incidents-bot: PAGER: gpu-autoscaler-queue-growth detected in prod-cluster-eu-west-1 — queue length > 600 for 7m, latency SLOs breached. paging oncall @julie :rotating_light:
julie (oncall): I'm on it. joining Zoom in 2.
julie (oncall): quick note — alert shows repeated failed scaleups, errors show 'AttachInstanceProfile: UnauthorizedOperation' and 'IMDSv2 token required'.
miguel: seeing same in logs. suspected recent LT (launch template) rollout yesterday.
sarah: adding context — we rolled a new launch-template version v3 at 02:10 UTC to pick up kernel fix. It changed `IamInstanceProfile` ARN to a new role: `redwood-gpu-node-role-v2`.
raj: logs from autoscaler: ```time="2026-02-14T09:27:03Z" level=error msg="failed to launch instance: RunInstances error: UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform this action"
caused_by: AttachRole: AttachRole failed for profile arn:aws:iam::123456789012:instance-profile/redwood-gpu-node-role-v2
```
julie (oncall): hmm. Could be the instance profile hasn't been trusted by the ASG or there is a service-linked role requirement. miguel, can you check nodegroup auto-provision IAM change?
miguel: checking. `aws autoscaling describe-launch-configurations` shows LT v3 ARN present, but `ec2:RunInstances` attempts mention `Missing or invalid serial` for IMDSv2. Some instances tried but weren't fully created and were terminated.
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline finished rollout to eu-west-1 at 2026-02-14T02:11:26Z, LT v3 applied to nodegroup gpu-pool-02.
aly (cs): customers reporting degraded transform jobs. ETA on mitigation? we have a major customer running overnight batch.
sarah: possible causes: 1) new AMI/provision hooks require IMDSv2 enforcement, 2) instance profile not allowed for ASG assume role (passrole) i.e., missing iam:PassRole on pipeline principal, 3) node taints set incorrectly causing scheduler backpressure.
raj: I see ASG events: `ProvisioningFailed: Could not launch instances: AccessDenied: ec2:RunInstances` and later `capacity-queued`. Autoscaler saw launch failures and backed off, queue grew.
julie (oncall): mitigation options: a) roll LT back to previous version v2, b) manually attach legacy instance profile and bump ASG, c) temporarily open fallback to dedicated-host pool (we have spare dedicated GPUs in us-west but cross-region adds latency). Preference is quick rollback.
miguel: I can rollback LT in ~6 min via console. need approval to trigger ASAP.
julie (oncall): do it. miguel, rollback LT to v2 and scale up min size by 2 to force new instances (with v2). Monitor.
miguel: rolling back now. hitting console weirdness — `UpdateAutoScalingGroup` returns `ValidationError: LaunchTemplateId does not match`. Trying to set LaunchTemplateVersion to 2 instead of replacing.
raj: autoscaler still logging repeated `launchTemplate: version mismatch` errors. Might be autoscaler caching old descriptor — restarting autoscaler might help.
sarah: be careful restarting autoscaler could trigger churn. Instead, annotate nodegroup to force refresh, or update ASG tags to new LT version. miguel, continue with version pin.
miguel: pinned to version 2. ASG update accepted. kicking off `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-pool-02 --desired-capacity 6` (was 4).
julie (oncall): good. now watch events. julie is keeping eyes on queue and latency dashboard.
(2m)
miguel: new run attempts now show `RunInstances initiated` and `Instance launched` but IMDS health check shows `IMDSv2 required` failing during cloud-init, instance gets stuck in `Initializing` and then `Terminated` after 3m with `Instance profile not attached`.
raj: that matches a race: new LT changed instance profile reference; but ASG instance-profile attaches post-launch in our flow and IMDSv2 requirement causes bootstrap to attempt metadata calls earlier. If profile not present at that precise time, bootstrap fails.
aly (cs): customer impact: A -> 95% of inference queues delayed; B -> batch jobs delayed, CS is triaging direct outreach to top customers.
julie (oncall): mitigation plan v2: 1) temporarily revert IMDS requirement in userdata (if doable) — risky. 2) ensure instance-profile is present in LT before launch — but LT already references it. 3) short term: move some service routes to fallback smaller model on hosted API to relieve GPU queue (handled by traffic-shifts). I'll coordinate with platform team to enable fallback routing.
sarah: I can flip fallback routing for a limited percentage. That will drop GPU queue by ~30% expected. Proceed?
julie (oncall): yes do it. sarah, open PR to change routing flags and roll to 10% then 50% if stable.
sarah: flipping now. `PATCH /routes/serve?fallback=true&percent=10` -> 200 OK. Metrics: queue length down 18% in 3m. latency still high but improving.
miguel: meanwhile, I'm going to restart the cluster-autoscaler pod to clear cache and force it to re-evaluate launch template metadata. Doing `kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deployment/cluster-autoscaler`.
raj: note: when CA restarted it logged `failed to parse launch template v3: missing IamInstanceProfile` — after restart it's reading v2 now.
miguel: new instances booted successfully with v2 and attached instance profile. Nodes become Ready. Scheduler started placing pods. GPU queue draining.
raj: autoscaler now showing scale activity: scaled to 6, no further failures.
julie (oncall): status update: fallback routing 10% -> 50% yielded queue reduction to baseline ~120; autoscaler healthy, new nodes up. I'm going to keep incident open and monitor for 30m. Notifying CS.
aly (cs): telling impacted customers we have a mitigation in place and jobs will backfill over next hour. keeping them updated.
deploy-bot: alert: announcement channel updated with incident link.
(20m)
julie (oncall): postmortem notes to capture: - LT rollout v3 introduced IMDSv2 enforcement and new instance-profile reference. - CI/CD pipeline didn't validate IAM passrole for new profile to ASG principal. - cluster-autoscaler cache sensitivity to LT version required restart to re-evaluate. - recommend preflight: canary ASG with warm nodes, IAM integration test, and staged LT rollout with autoscaler refresh webhook.
sarah: I'll open an RFC for launch-template rollout automation to include: IAM assume/passrole check, IMDS enforcement compatibility, and an autoscaler-refresh hook.
miguel: created short-term patch: add a rollout step to ensure `iam:PassRole` exists for the pipeline principal and a smoke test that simulates `RunInstances` success. PR: #8421
julie (oncall): closing on-call shift notes: incident mitigated, queue draining, customer impact limited to delayed batches. I'll hand this to SRE for full postmortem. tagging @raj for follow-up.
raj: taking postmortem. thanks all. :thumbsup:
summary: GPU capacity alert due to autoscaler failing to launch instances after launch-template rollout. Root causes: IMDSv2 enforcement timing race and instance-profile IAM/passrole mismatch; autoscaler cache required restart. Mitigations: rollback LT version, restart autoscaler, enable fallback routing and customer communications.
